zh.title: 让眼球运动留下物理轨迹
zh.summary: Huey 的早期阅读研究使用与眼部接触的记录装置，1908 年专著系统整理了相关方法。这一时期，人们尝试把短暂的眼球运动变成可检查的记录。
zh.change: 从主观观察走向仪器记录。
zh.limit: 接触眼部的装置影响舒适性，也会限制自然观看。

en.title: Leaving a physical trace of eye movement
en.summary: Huey’s early reading work used contact-based recording equipment, documented in his 1908 monograph. Researchers were turning fleeting eye movements into records that could be inspected.
en.change: A shift from observation toward instrumented recording.
en.limit: Contact with the eye affected comfort and constrained natural viewing.

zh.title: 用光学摄影记录眼动
zh.summary: Dodge 与 Cline 发表眼球运动角速度研究，使用摄影记录路线，使测量不必依赖眼部的机械连接。
zh.change: 光学记录成为重要的非接触测量方向。
zh.limit: 早期装置仍依赖受控姿态，记录维度和后续分析受到限制。

en.title: Recording the eyes with photography
en.summary: Dodge and Cline published their study of eye-movement angular velocity using photographic recording, offering an optical route without mechanical attachment to the eye.
en.change: Optical recording became an important non-contact approach.
en.limit: Early apparatus still depended on controlled positioning and limited recording and analysis capabilities.

zh.title: 从阅读扩展到看图
zh.summary: Buswell 在《How People Look at Pictures》中研究观看艺术作品时的注视分布与路径。眼动记录开始帮助比较不同观看者如何探索复杂图像。
zh.change: 研究问题扩展到图像知觉和视觉探索。
zh.limit: 记录路径不等于直接读出注意、理解或观看意图。

en.title: From reading to looking at pictures
en.summary: Buswell’s How People Look at Pictures examined fixation distributions and viewing paths over artworks, enabling comparisons of how people explore complex images.
en.change: Research expanded into picture perception and visual exploration.
en.limit: A recorded scanpath does not directly reveal attention, comprehension, or intent.

zh.title: 记录装置开始跟随头部
zh.summary: Hartridge 与 Thomson 发表眼动调查方法，展示把记录装置与头部关联的早期技术路线，为后来头戴式追踪的发展提供了基础。
zh.change: 不再只考虑把被试固定在外部仪器前。
zh.limit: 早期头戴结构仍有体积、固定方式和活动范围的限制。

en.title: Bringing the recorder with the head
en.summary: Hartridge and Thomson published methods for investigating eye movements, including an early head-associated recording approach that contributed to later head-mounted tracking.
en.change: Researchers explored alternatives to holding the observer in front of fixed equipment.
en.limit: Early head-mounted arrangements still imposed mounting, size, and movement constraints.

zh.title: 搜索线圈：从磁场测量眼球转动
zh.summary: Robinson 发表巩膜搜索线圈方法：通过眼部线圈在磁场中的感应信号记录眼球运动。这是与相机式追踪不同的测量分支。
zh.change: 为精密眼球运动研究提供了重要工具。
zh.limit: 需要专门磁场与眼部接触装置；不能理解成普通无接触桌面眼动仪。

en.title: Search coils measure rotation through magnetic fields
en.summary: Robinson introduced scleral search-coil measurement: signals induced in an eye-mounted coil record eye movement in a magnetic field. This is a different branch from camera-based tracking.
en.change: An important instrument for precise oculomotor research.
en.limit: It requires specialized fields and an eye-contact device, rather than a conventional non-contact desktop setup.

zh.title: 同一画面，不同任务，不同视线
zh.summary: Yarbus 的专著于 1965 年出版俄文版，1967 年出版英文版。其任务指令实验使眼动与观看目的之间的关系成为经典研究问题。
zh.change: 记录眼睛去了哪里，也开始追问为什么这样看。
zh.limit: 经典示例不能证明仅凭一条视线轨迹就能可靠识别一个人的思想。

en.title: The same scene, a different task, a different scanpath
en.summary: Yarbus’s monograph appeared in Russian in 1965 and English in 1967. His instruction-based experiments made the relationship between task and viewing behavior a landmark research question.
en.change: Beyond where the eyes move: why the observer looks that way.
en.limit: The classic examples do not establish reliable mind-reading from an individual scanpath.

zh.title: 双 Purkinje 图像：更精细的光学追踪
zh.summary: Cornsweet 与 Crane 描述利用第一、第四 Purkinje 图像的二维眼动仪，在红外下测量眼球运动，且不需要把装置附着在眼球上。
zh.change: 高精度光学测量与减少眼部接触可以同时推进。
zh.limit: 复杂光学结构和工作范围仍会约束实验布置；不是所有红外设备都属于双 Purkinje 系统。

en.title: Dual Purkinje images refine optical tracking
en.summary: Cornsweet and Crane described a two-dimensional tracker using the first and fourth Purkinje images in infrared, without attaching a device to the eyeball.
en.change: Precision optical measurement could advance alongside reduced eye contact.
en.limit: Optical complexity and working range constrain the setup; not every infrared tracker is a dual-Purkinje system.

zh.title: 眼动成为检验阅读认知理论的工具
zh.summary: Just 与 Carpenter 的阅读理论论文把眼睛的注视行为与理解过程联系起来，体现了眼动指标在认知研究中的作用。
zh.change: 硬件输出成为可以与认知理论对照的时间序列。
zh.limit: 注视时长需要结合任务与理论解释，并不是某个心理过程的唯一标签。

en.title: Eye movements test theories of reading
en.summary: Just and Carpenter’s reading-theory paper connected fixation behavior with comprehension, illustrating the role of eye measurements in cognitive research.
en.change: Instrument output became evidence to test accounts of mental processing.
en.limit: Fixation duration requires task and theoretical context; it is not a unique label for a mental process.

zh.title: 眼睛也可以成为电脑输入
zh.summary: Hutchinson 等人介绍 Erica 工作站，以眼睛图像估计屏幕凝视位置，并通过菜单选择操作电脑；论文也讨论其辅助技术应用。
zh.change: 眼动从观察工具延伸为访问和沟通通道。
zh.limit: 可用性取决于选择机制、误触、校准与持续使用体验，而不仅是采样频率。

en.title: Eye gaze becomes computer input
en.summary: Hutchinson and colleagues described the Erica workstation, estimating screen gaze from eye images to operate menus, including applications as an assistive device.
en.change: Eye tracking extended from observation to access and communication.
en.limit: Usability depends on selection, accidental activation, calibration, and sustained use—not sampling rate alone.

zh.title: 如何区分“看”与“想要操作”
zh.summary: Jacob 在 CHI 1990 讨论基于眼动的人机交互技术。研究焦点逐渐从能否测量凝视，转向如何把自然观看变成可靠输入。
zh.change: 交互设计成为与传感器同样重要的问题。
zh.limit: 用户看向一个对象，并不自动代表想要激活它；仍需设计确认与反馈。

en.title: Distinguishing looking from acting
en.summary: Jacob’s CHI 1990 paper examined eye-movement interaction techniques, shifting attention from measuring gaze to incorporating it naturally into human–computer dialogue.
en.change: Interaction design became as important as the sensing hardware.
en.limit: Looking at an object does not automatically mean activating it; confirmation and feedback still need design.

zh.title: 远程眼动走向更易部署的产品
zh.summary: Tobii 的公司史记录了 2001 年成立、2002 年推出眼动产品的过程。这是屏幕式研究工具降低部署门槛的一个代表性商业节点。
zh.change: 校准、采集与分析开始形成更完整的产品工作流。
zh.limit: 这是特定厂商的节点，不是全球所有商业眼动仪的起点。

en.title: Remote eye tracking becomes easier to deploy
en.summary: Tobii’s company history records its founding in 2001 and first tracker in 2002: a representative commercial milestone in making screen-based research easier to deploy.
en.change: Calibration, acquisition, and analysis increasingly formed product workflows.
en.limit: This is a company milestone, not the beginning of all commercial eye tracking.

zh.title: 开源可穿戴平台推动定制研究
zh.summary: Kassner、Patera 与 Bulling 发表 Pupil 平台论文，将可穿戴相机、开源软件和回放可视化结合，强调可扩展与可定制。
zh.change: 研究者可以更直接地修改采集和处理流程。
zh.limit: 开放软件不等于完全没有硬件、校准或维护成本；论文原型参数也不能套用到后来所有型号。

en.title: An open wearable platform supports custom research
en.summary: Kassner, Patera, and Bulling presented Pupil, combining wearable cameras, open-source software, and replay visualization with an emphasis on extensibility.
en.change: Researchers gained more direct control over acquisition and processing.
en.limit: Open software does not remove hardware, calibration, or maintenance costs; prototype results do not apply to every later model.

zh.title: 普通摄像头与数据驱动凝视估计
zh.summary: GazeCapture / iTracker 研究使用手机和平板数据训练神经网络，探索不增加专用传感器的凝视估计。它代表软件化与规模化的一条重要路线。
zh.change: 扩大了可使用的硬件与参与人群范围。
zh.limit: 软件估计与专用仪器的输出单位、误差与测试条件不同，不能直接等同于科研级硬件表现。

en.title: Commodity cameras meet learned gaze estimation
en.summary: GazeCapture / iTracker used phone and tablet data to train a neural network, exploring gaze estimation without additional dedicated sensors. It represents an important software-driven route.
en.change: A broader hardware and participant base became possible.
en.limit: Output units, errors, and test conditions differ from dedicated instruments; the approaches are not interchangeable by default.

zh.title: 深度学习走进日常外形的眼镜
zh.summary: Pupil Labs 在 2019 年推出 Pupil Invisible，将学习式凝视估计带入更接近日常眼镜的形态，并弱化传统逐人校准流程。
zh.change: 自然佩戴和准备时间成为重要的产品设计目标。
zh.limit: 免校准不等于零误差，仍需针对任务、光线和人群验证数据质量。

en.title: Learned estimation reaches everyday-looking glasses
en.summary: Pupil Labs released Pupil Invisible in 2019, bringing learned gaze estimation to an everyday-glasses form factor with a reduced reliance on conventional per-user calibration.
en.change: Natural wear and preparation time became major product goals.
en.limit: Calibration-free does not mean error-free; validate quality for the task, lighting, and participants.

zh.title: 眼动成为透视式 AR 的空间输入
zh.summary: HoloLens 2 于 2019 年开始交付，将眼动与手势、空间计算结合。开发者可以在获得权限后使用凝视信息构建交互。
zh.change: 凝视从二维屏幕位置扩展到空间中的方向与目标。
zh.limit: 标准与扩展接口的数据不同；许可、校准和系统 API 决定实际可用信息。

en.title: Gaze becomes spatial input in see-through AR
en.summary: HoloLens 2 began shipping in 2019, combining eye tracking, hand interaction, and spatial computing. Permissioned gaze information enabled application interaction.
en.change: Gaze extended beyond a 2D screen into spatial directions and targets.
en.limit: Standard and extended APIs expose different data; permission, calibration, and API support determine availability.

zh.title: MEMS：不依赖眼部成像相机的另一分支
zh.summary: AdHawk 在 2021 年发布 MindLink，以 MEMS 传感路线进行眼动测量，展示了传统视频式方案之外的可穿戴设计选择。
zh.change: 小型化与功耗问题可以通过不同传感架构探索。
zh.limit: 技术路线不同，也意味着数据定义和验证方式需要重新核对；发布公告不代表当前仍有供货。

en.title: MEMS offers a branch beyond eye-imaging cameras
en.summary: AdHawk announced MindLink in 2021, using MEMS-based sensing to demonstrate a wearable alternative to conventional video-based tracking.
en.change: Miniaturization and power consumption could be addressed through another sensing architecture.
en.limit: Different sensing requires checking data definitions and validation; a launch notice does not establish current stock.

zh.title: XR 设备整合眼动与虚拟化身表达
zh.summary: Meta Quest Pro 于 2022 年上市，内置眼动和面部追踪，服务于虚拟化身、社交临场感与混合现实体验。
zh.change: 眼动开始作为完整 XR 体验中的一项内置能力。
zh.limit: 内置传感器不等于向所有应用开放全部原始信号。

en.title: XR integrates gaze and avatar expression
en.summary: Meta Quest Pro became available in 2022 with eye and facial tracking for avatars, social presence, and mixed-reality experiences.
en.change: Eye tracking became an integrated capability within an XR experience.
en.limit: Built-in sensing does not mean all raw signals are exposed to every application.

zh.title: 主机 VR 把眼动带入游戏体验
zh.summary: PlayStation VR2 于 2023 年 2 月 22 日推出，在支持的内容中使用眼动，例如角色视线互动与注视相关体验。
zh.change: 眼动进入主机平台的内容与交互生态。
zh.limit: 功能取决于应用和运行平台；主机功能不能直接视作开放科研数据接口。

en.title: Console VR brings gaze into games
en.summary: PlayStation VR2 launched on February 22, 2023, with eye tracking used in supported content, including gaze interactions with characters.
en.change: Gaze entered the console platform’s content and interaction ecosystem.
en.limit: Features depend on content and platform; console functionality is not an open research-data interface.

zh.title: 模块化眼镜与可扩展分析工作流
zh.summary: 2023 年的官方公告已记录 Neon 的镜架与产品更新。其模块化设计把传感硬件、不同佩戴形态与分析工具连接起来。
zh.change: 同一传感模块可以适配更多研究场景。
zh.limit: 此处年份表示已有同期官方资料，不把现行规格当作 2023 年所有功能的发布记录。

en.title: Modular glasses and expandable analysis workflows
en.summary: Official announcements in 2023 document Neon frames and product updates. Its modular design connects sensing hardware, different wearing configurations, and analysis tools.
en.change: A sensing module can be adapted to more research settings.
en.limit: The year marks contemporaneous documentation; current specifications are not treated as a list of features launched in 2023.

zh.title: 眼睛成为空间系统的主要输入之一
zh.summary: Apple Vision Pro 于 2024 年 2 月 2 日在美国上市，以眼睛、手势与语音组织系统交互，展示了以凝视为核心的空间界面设计。
zh.change: 眼动从单个应用功能走向系统级交互方式。
zh.limit: 系统能使用凝视，不代表普通应用能读取持续眼动数据；隐私边界是架构的一部分。

en.title: Eyes become a primary spatial-system input
en.summary: Apple Vision Pro became available in the U.S. on February 2, 2024, organizing system interaction around eyes, hands, and voice.
en.change: Gaze moved from an application feature toward system-level interaction.
en.limit: System use of gaze does not give ordinary apps continuous eye-tracking data; privacy boundaries are part of the architecture.

zh.title: 眼动与脑、身体信号整合
zh.summary: OpenBCI 与 Pupil Labs 于 2025 年 10 月宣布 Galea Neon，把眼动与多种生理信号整合到同一可穿戴平台，面向多模态行为研究。
zh.change: 研究重点继续扩展到同步、数据融合和跨场景采集。
zh.limit: 厂商整合与同步主张仍需按具体实验验证；这是系统集成节点，并不意味着此前没有多模态研究。

en.title: Integrating eye, brain, and body signals
en.summary: OpenBCI and Pupil Labs announced Galea Neon in October 2025, combining eye tracking and physiological signals in a wearable platform for multimodal research.
en.change: Synchronization, data fusion, and recording across settings became central integration goals.
en.limit: Validate manufacturer integration claims in the experiment; this milestone does not imply multimodal research began in 2025.
